    Spring [ attribute = nc, to = { this.root.ncTo }, stiffness = 150, damping = 24, mass = 0.9, epsilon = 0.002 ],
    Spring [ attribute = nr, to = { this.root.nrTo }, stiffness = 150, damping = 24, mass = 0.9, epsilon = 0.002 ],
    colW: number = { (this.root.bodyW - 2 * this.root.pad - this.root.gutter) / this.root.nc },
    rowH: number = { (this.root.bodyH - this.root.headH) / this.root.nr },

    // 0 = month chips, 1 = time blocks. Keyed on the focus span (one focused
    // row **is** a time view), never on pixel height: a short-landscape day
    // still resolves to blocks, and a tall monitor's month can never start
    // half-morphing its chips. Riding `nr` also keeps the morph continuous:
    // chips hold shape while the focus zooms, then resolve into blocks over
    // the last row of travel.

    blockness: number = { this.root.clamp(2 - this.root.nr, 0, 1) },

    gutter: number = { this.root.blockness * 52 },                             // hour-label gutter, opens in time views

    /* Year zoom: `yearZoom` (0→1) shrinks the month surface into its slot in the 4×3 year
       grid while the other eleven months resolve around it. `yearScale` scales the
       surface and the surrounding grid in lock-step. */

    myCol: number = { (this.root.month - 1) % 4 },
    myRow: number = { Math.floor((this.root.month - 1) / 4) },
    slotX: number = { this.root.pad + this.root.myCol * (this.root.miniW + this.root.gap) },
    slotY: number = { this.root.pad + this.root.myRow * (this.root.miniH + this.root.gap) },
    yearScale: number = { this.root.lerp(this.root.bodyW / this.root.miniW, 1, this.root.yearZoom) },
    yearZoom: number = 0,
    Spring [ attribute = yearZoom, to = { this.root.mode == "year" ? 1 : 0 }, stiffness = 150, damping = 24, mass = 0.9, epsilon = 0.002 ],

    periodLabel: string = {
        this.root.mode == "year"  ? "" + this.root.year
      : this.root.mode == "month" ? this.root.monthName(this.root.month) + " " + this.root.year
      : this.root.mode == "week"  ? this.root.weekLabel(this.root.anchorKey)
      :                       this.root.dayLabel(this.root.anchorKey) },

    // ── helpers ──

    lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number) -> number { return a + (b - a) * t },
    clamp(v: number, a: number, b: number) -> number { return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v)) },

    // blend two 0xRRGGBB colors channel-wise

    mix(a: number, b: number, t: number) -> number {
        const c = (x, y) => Math.round(x + (y - x) * t)
        return (c((a >> 16) & 255, (b >> 16) & 255) << 16) | (c((a >> 8) & 255, (b >> 8) & 255) << 8) | c(a & 255, b & 255)
        },
    monthName(m: number) -> string { return ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"][m - 1] },
    dowName(i: number) -> string { return ["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"][i] },
    dowLong(i: number) -> string { return ["Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday"][i] },
    keyOf(dt: object) -> string { return dt.getFullYear() + "-" + (dt.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + dt.getDate() },
    parseKey(k: string) -> object { const p = k.split("-").map(Number); return new Date(p[0], p[1] - 1, p[2]) },
    gridIndexOf(key: string) -> number {                       // a day's 0..41 slot in the month grid
        const first = new Date(this.year, this.month - 1, 1)
        const start = new Date(this.year, this.month - 1, 1 - first.getDay())
        const d = this.root.parseKey(key)
        return Math.round((Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate())
                         - Date.UTC(start.getFullYear(), start.getMonth(), start.getDate())) / 86400000)
        },
    shortTime(min: number) -> string {
        const h = Math.floor(min / 60), mm = min % 60, ap = h < 12 ? "a" : "p"
        let hh = h % 12; if (hh == 0) hh = 12
        return mm == 0 ? hh + ap : hh + ":" + (mm < 10 ? "0" + mm : "" + mm) + ap
        },
    hourLabel(h: number) -> string { const ap = h < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"; let hh = h % 12; if (hh == 0) hh = 12; return hh + " " + ap },
    weekLabel(k: string) -> string {
        const d = this.root.parseKey(k)
        const s = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate() - d.getDay())
        const e = new Date(s.getFullYear(), s.getMonth(), s.getDate() + 6)
        return this.root.monthName(s.getMonth() + 1) + " " + s.getDate() + " – "
             + (s.getMonth() == e.getMonth() ? "" : this.root.monthName(e.getMonth() + 1) + " ") + e.getDate()
        },
    dayLabel(k: string) -> string { const d = this.root.parseKey(k); return this.root.dowLong(d.getDay()) + ", " + this.root.monthName(d.getMonth() + 1) + " " + d.getDate() },

    // -> number, not Color: these return a concrete 0xRRGGBB (theme slots are
    // never null at read time), and number is what mix() blends — a nullable
    // Color return would refuse every mix(catFill(…), …) call site.

    catFill(c: string) -> number { const t = this.$provided("theme"); return c == "holiday" ? t.holidayBg : c == "astro" ? t.astroBg : c == "milestone" ? t.milestoneBg : t.defaultBg },
    catText(c: string) -> number { const t = this.$provided("theme"); return c == "holiday" ? t.holidayText : c == "astro" ? t.astroText : c == "milestone" ? t.milestoneText : t.defaultText },

    /* ── the two palettes — every color in the app, named by role ──

       Light is house San Francisco: `bg`, `line`, `text`, `textMuted`,
       `textFaint`, `accent`, `control` and `controlSelected` are the preset's own
       values, to the byte.

       Dark deliberately is not, and the reason is the grid. House dark is
       stepped — bg → surface → control each a visible rung apart (ΔE 5.4 and
       7.7). A month is a 2D tiling of 42 equal cells, and stepped surfaces there
       read as corduroy, so this palette is flat and deep instead (the same two
       gaps, ΔE 2.6 and 2.5) with one bright exception: `controlSelected` sits 4 L*
       above house so the selection still pops out of the quiet field.
       `textMuted` drops ~8 L* to hold its hierarchy against the flatter
       surfaces. `text` and `accent` are house exactly, in both modes.

       This is the corpus's only 2D-tiled surface — the tracker is a list, with
       rules between its rows, and runs house dark untouched. So this stays an
       app palette rather than a second preset: one example is not a pattern. */

    darkTheme() { return ({
        bg: 0x0D151E, surface: 0x101A24, cellBg: 0x18242F, outOfMonthBg: 0x101922, weekendBg: 0x141F2A,
        todayBg: 0x14304F, dropTargetBg: 0x1E3C5E, dropTargetRing: 0x6BA4F0, line: 0x22323E, gridLine: 0x1B2934,
        text: 0xE7EEF2, textMuted: 0x8A9BA6, textFaint: 0x54626E, dayNumber: 0xC7D3DC, bodyText: 0xB4C2CC,
        hourLabel: 0x53636F,
        accent: 0x4C8DFF, accentSecondary: 0x37E0C8, currentDayText: 0x9CC4FF, todayText: 0x7FB0FF,
        control: 0x131F29, controlSelected: 0x244463,
        fieldBg: 0x0F1A25, fieldEdge: 0x2A3B49,
        sectionBg: 0x16222E, sectionOpenBg: 0x1B2B3B,
        miniBg: 0x121C26, miniCurrentBg: 0x14283F, miniDayText: 0x9FB0BB, miniDayFaint: 0x33414C,
        holidayBg: 0x14321F, holidayText: 0x74D89B, astroBg: 0x241F3D, astroText: 0xB6A6F0,
        milestoneBg: 0x33280F, milestoneText: 0xF0C36B, defaultBg: 0x123050, defaultText: 0x8FB6F0 }) },
    lightTheme() { return ({
        bg: 0xF4F6FA, surface: 0xFFFFFF, cellBg: 0xFFFFFF, outOfMonthBg: 0xEDF0F5, weekendBg: 0xF1F4F8,
        todayBg: 0xDCE9FF, dropTargetBg: 0xC7DDFF, dropTargetRing: 0x2E6FE0, line: 0xDBE1E9, gridLine: 0xE4E9EF,
        text: 0x1B2733, textMuted: 0x6C7A88, textFaint: 0xAAB4BE, dayNumber: 0x2A3542, bodyText: 0x3E4C59,
        hourLabel: 0x99A5B0,
        accent: 0x2E6FE0, accentSecondary: 0x12A594, currentDayText: 0x2E6FE0, todayText: 0x2E6FE0,
        control: 0xE7EBF1, controlSelected: 0xD3E2FC,
        fieldBg: 0xFFFFFF, fieldEdge: 0xDBE1E9,
        sectionBg: 0xF1F5F9, sectionOpenBg: 0xE6EEF8,
        miniBg: 0xFFFFFF, miniCurrentBg: 0xE7F0FF, miniDayText: 0x3E4C59, miniDayFaint: 0xBFC8D2,
        holidayBg: 0xDCF3E4, holidayText: 0x1E7A44, astroBg: 0xEBE6FB, astroText: 0x5B3FB8,
        milestoneBg: 0xFBEFD6, milestoneText: 0x9A6A11, defaultBg: 0xDCE8FE, defaultText: 0x2456B0 }) },
    eventsOn(all: array, y: number, m: number, d: number) -> array {
        return all.filter(e => e.y == y && e.m == m && e.d == d).sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || a.id - b.id)
                  .map((e, i) => Object.assign({}, e, { timeLabel: this.root.shortTime(e.start), idx: i, dur: e.end - e.start }))
        },
    computeMonthRows() {
        const first = new Date(this.year, this.month - 1, 1)
        return Math.ceil((first.getDay() + new Date(this.year, this.month, 0).getDate()) / 7)
        },

    /* ## The model
       `buildModel` builds the visible month's grid, each day carrying a copy of its
       events tagged with its grid row (so only the focused row morphs to blocks).
       `buildMonths` builds the year's twelve minis; its only tracked input is the
       year, so it rebuilds once a year and never on a view switch. */

    buildModel() {
        const all = this.root.data.read(["events"]) ?? []
        const cols = [0,1,2,3,4,5,6].map(i => ({ name: this.root.dowName(i), col: i }))
        const hours = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, h) => ({ h: h, label: this.root.hourLabel(h) }))
        const first = new Date(this.year, this.month - 1, 1)
        const start = new Date(this.year, this.month - 1, 1 - first.getDay())
        const rows = this.root.computeMonthRows()
        const grid = []
        for (let i = 0; i < rows * 7; i++) {
            const dt = new Date(start.getFullYear(), start.getMonth(), start.getDate() + i)
            const row = Math.floor(i / 7)
            grid.push({ key: this.root.keyOf(dt), num: dt.getDate(), dow: this.root.dowName(dt.getDay()), col: i % 7, row: row,
                        inMonth: dt.getMonth() == this.month - 1, weekend: dt.getDay() == 0 || dt.getDay() == 6,
                        today: this.root.keyOf(dt) == this.todayKey, current: this.root.keyOf(dt) == this.anchorKey,
                        events: this.root.eventsOn(all, dt.getFullYear(), dt.getMonth() + 1, dt.getDate()).map(e => Object.assign({}, e, { dayRow: row })) })
            }
        return { grid: grid, cols: cols, hours: hours }
        },
    buildMonths() {
        const all = this.root.data.value != null ? this.root.data.value.events : []
        const months = []
        for (let m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
            const st = new Date(this.year, m - 1, 1 - new Date(this.year, m - 1, 1).getDay())
            const cells = []
            for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
                const dt = new Date(st.getFullYear(), st.getMonth(), st.getDate() + i)
                cells.push({ num: dt.getDate(), col: i % 7, row: Math.floor(i / 7), inMonth: dt.getMonth() == m - 1,
                             today: this.root.keyOf(dt) == this.todayKey,
                             has: dt.getMonth() == m - 1 && all.some(e => e.y == dt.getFullYear() && e.m == m && e.d == dt.getDate()) })
                }
            months.push({ m: m, name: this.root.monthName(m), mcol: (m - 1) % 4, mrow: Math.floor((m - 1) / 4), cells: cells })
            }
        return { months: months }
        },
    emptyYear() { return { months: [] } },

    /* ## Navigation
       A view switch is just a new `mode` (the focus rect springs); a page turn is
       a new navYear/navMonth/navKey. The model derives from those, so navigation
       only sets state — and `today()` is a return to the defaults. */

    goMode(m: string) { this.selectedId = -1; this.mode = m; if (m == "year") this.yearSeen = true },
    pickDay(key: string) {
        const d = this.root.parseKey(key)
        this.navKey = key; this.navYear = d.getFullYear(); this.navMonth = d.getMonth() + 1; this.selectedId = -1; this.mode = "day"
        },
    pickMonth(m: number) { this.navMonth = m; this.selectedId = -1; this.mode = "month" },
    today()       { this.navYear = 0; this.navMonth = 0; this.navKey = "" },
    step(dir: number) {
        const a = this.root.parseKey(this.anchorKey)      // paging keeps the anchor day coherent
        if (this.mode == "year") {
            const y = this.year + dir
            this.navYear = y
            this.navKey = y + "-" + (a.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + Math.min(a.getDate(), new Date(y, a.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate())
        } else if (this.mode == "month") {
            let m = this.month + dir, y = this.year
            if (m < 1) { m = 12; y-- } else if (m > 12) { m = 1; y++ }
            this.navMonth = m; this.navYear = y
            this.navKey = y + "-" + m + "-" + Math.min(a.getDate(), new Date(y, m, 0).getDate())
        } else {
            const n = new Date(a.getFullYear(), a.getMonth(), a.getDate() + dir * (this.mode == "week" ? 7 : 1))
            this.navKey = this.root.keyOf(n); this.navYear = n.getFullYear(); this.navMonth = n.getMonth() + 1
            }
        },
    selectEvent(id: number, key: string?) {
        this.selectedId = id; this.openSection = 0
        if (key != null) this.navKey = key
        },
    closeDetail() { this.selectedId = -1 },

    /* ## Drag to reschedule
       Pointer capture, plus the runtime's click rule, give click-vs-drag for
       free: a gesture that moved is a drag and clicks nothing, so the block's
       `onClick` fires only on a real tap. The threshold below is the app's own
       (when the ghost appears), not a click suppressor. A drop writes through
       the dataset's mutation API, so it wakes the derived model exactly like a
       title edit — no copy to rebuild. */

    startDrag(id: number, title: string, cat: string, timeLabel: string, w: number, h: number, gx: number, gy: number) {
        this.dragId = id; this.dragTitle = title; this.dragCat = cat; this.dragTimeLabel = timeLabel
        this.dragW = w; this.dragH = h; this.grabDX = gx; this.grabDY = gy
        this.dragging = false; this.dropKey = ""; this.downX = this.pointerX; this.downY = this.pointerY
        },
    dragMove() {
        if (this.dragId < 0) return
        if (!this.dragging) {
            const dx = this.pointerX - this.downX, dy = this.pointerY - this.downY
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy > 16) this.dragging = true
            }
        if (this.dragging) { const cell = this.cellAt(this.pointerX, this.pointerY); this.dropKey = cell != null ? cell.key : "" }
        },
    armDrag() {
        // The chip's hold fired: lift the ghost at once, before any movement —
        // on touch this is the moment the claim engages, and the pickup should
        // be visible while the finger is still parked.
        if (this.dragId < 0) return
        this.dragging = true
        const cell = this.cellAt(this.pointerX, this.pointerY); this.dropKey = cell != null ? cell.key : ""
        },
    dropDrag(px: number, py: number, canceled: boolean) {
        if (this.dragId < 0) return
        // A drag never clicks — the runtime's own rule (a gesture whose pointer
        // wandered past slop resolves to no click), so the drop just commits —
        // but never an interrupted one: on touch the browser may take the
        // gesture for a scroll (a quick swipe over a chip), and that release
        // must not move the event to wherever the finger happened to be.
        if (this.dragging && !canceled) this.commitDrop(px, py)
        this.dragId = -1; this.dragging = false; this.dropKey = ""
        },
    cellAt(px: number, py: number) -> object {                         // invert the span mapping: screen point → grid cell
        const col = Math.floor((px - this.pad - this.gutter) / this.colW + this.c0)
        const row = Math.floor((py - this.barH - this.headH) / this.rowH + this.r0)
        return this.cal.value.grid[this.root.clamp(row, 0, this.monthRows - 1) * 7 + this.root.clamp(col, 0, 6)]
        },
    commitDrop(px: number, py: number) {
        const events = this.root.data.value != null ? this.root.data.value.events : []
        const idx = events.findIndex(e => e.id == this.dragId)
        if (idx < 0) return
        const ev = events[idx], p = ["events", idx]
        const cell = this.cellAt(px, py)
        if (cell != null) { const d = this.root.parseKey(cell.key); this.root.data.set([...p, "y"], d.getFullYear()); this.root.data.set([...p, "m"], d.getMonth() + 1); this.root.data.set([...p, "d"], d.getDate()) }
        if (this.blockness > 0.5) {          // a time view: also reschedule from the drop height
            const dur = ev.end - ev.start
            let s = Math.round(((py - this.barH - this.headH - this.grabDY) / this.rowH * 1440) / 15) * 15
            s = this.root.clamp(s, 0, 1440 - dur); this.root.data.set([...p, "start"], s); this.root.data.set([...p, "end"], s + dur)
            }
        },

    /* ## Keyboard
       Arrows page the current view; Escape closes the detail panel. A Keys
       member — lifetime-managed, no listener to clean up. The arrows
       gate on the panel being closed: its text fields own the keyboard while
       an event is being edited (Keys is the raw stream). */

    keys: Keys [
        onKeyUp(e: KeyEvent) {
            if (e.key == "Escape") this.root.closeDetail()
            else if (this.root.selectedId < 0 && e.key == "ArrowLeft") this.root.step(-1)
            else if (this.root.selectedId < 0 && e.key == "ArrowRight") this.root.step(1)
            }
        ],

    /* ## The surface — day / week / month → year
       For year the surface does not scale into its slot; each Cell re-lays-out into
       the current month's slot (driven by `app.yearZoom`), so the month becomes its mini. The
       other eleven months are the deferred `yearCal`. */

    board: View [ x = 0, y = { this.root.barH }, width = { this.root.bodyW }, height = { this.root.bodyH }, clip = true,

        // the month's backdrop: authored at the destination slot and scaled up about
        // its centre, so it starts full-bleed and converges by a pure scale to the mini

        monthBg: View [ x = { this.root.slotX }, y = { this.root.slotY }, width = { this.root.miniW }, height = { this.root.miniH },
            cornerRadius = 12, fill = { this.root.mix(this.$provided("theme").bg, this.$provided("theme").miniCurrentBg, this.root.yearZoom) },
            scale = { this.root.yearScale }, pivotX = { this.root.miniW / 2 }, pivotY = { this.root.miniH / 2 } ],
        weekdays: View [ opacity = { (1 - this.root.blockness) * (1 - this.root.yearZoom) }, datapath = { this.root.cal.value },
            View [ datapath = :cols[], key = :col, x = { this.root.pad + this.$data(["col"]) * (this.root.bodyW - 2 * this.root.pad) / 7 + 11 },
                l: Text [ y = 9, fontSize = 11, wrap = false, textColor = { this.$provided("theme").textMuted }, text = { this.$data(["name"]) } ]
                ]
            ],
        hours: View [ opacity = { this.root.blockness }, datapath = { this.root.cal.value },
            View [ datapath = :hours[], key = :h, y = { this.root.headH + this.$data(["h"]) / 24 * (this.root.bodyH - this.root.headH) }, width = { this.root.bodyW }, height = 1, fill = { this.$provided("theme").gridLine },
                lbl: Text [ x = 6, y = 1, fontSize = 10, wrap = false, textColor = { this.$provided("theme").hourLabel }, text = { this.$data(["label"]) } ]
                ]
            ],
        grid: View [ datapath = { this.root.cal.value },
            Cell [ datapath = :grid[], key = :key ]
            ],
        yearName: Text [ x = { this.root.slotX + 14 }, y = { this.root.slotY + 11 }, fontSize = 13, fontWeight = semibold, wrap = false,
            textColor = { this.$provided("theme").todayText }, text = { this.root.monthName(this.root.month) },
            opacity = { this.root.clamp((this.root.yearZoom - 0.5) / 0.5, 0, 1) } ]
        ],

    /* ## Year — the same surface pulled back to the full 4×3 grid, the eleven other
       months sweeping in around the shrinking board. */

    yearView: View [ y = { this.root.barH }, width = { this.root.bodyW }, height = { this.root.bodyH }, clip = true, visible = { this.root.yearZoom > 0.02 },
        opacity = { this.root.clamp((this.root.yearZoom - 0.5) / 0.3, 0, 1) },
        scale = { this.root.yearScale }, pivotX = { this.root.slotX + this.root.miniW / 2 }, pivotY = { this.root.slotY + this.root.miniH / 2 },
        grid: View [ width = 100%, height = 100%, datapath = { this.root.yearCal.value },
            MiniMonth [ datapath = :months[], key = :m ]
            ]
        ],

    /* ## Event detail panel
       Points its datapath at the selected event, so every field two-way binds
       straight to the record and reseeds when a different event opens. */

    panel: View [ width = { this.root.panelW }, height = { this.root.bodyH }, y = { this.root.barH }, fill = { this.$provided("theme").surface }, x = { this.root.width - this.root.panelInset },
        datapath = { this.root.data.value != null ? this.root.data.value.events.find(e => e.id == this.root.selectedId) : null },
        edge: View [ width = 1, height = 100%, fill = { this.$provided("theme").line } ],
        secs: View [ x = 22, y = 24, width = { parent.width - 44 },
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 8 ],

            /* The event section — the title block in the sections' own grammar: the
               same card, its label row carrying the panel's close where the others
               carry their chevron, the category color as the card's left edge, and
               the read-only date · time under the editable title. */

            ev: View [ width = 100%, height = 112, cornerRadius = 10, clip = true, fill = { this.$provided("theme").sectionBg },
                rail: View [ width = 4, height = 100%, fill = { this.root.catText(this.$data(["category"])) } ],
                hdr: View [ width = 100%, height = 40,
                    lbl: Text [ x = 15, y = 16, fontSize = 12, fontWeight = bold, wrap = false, letterSpacing = 1,
                        textColor = { this.$provided("theme").textMuted }, text = "EVENT" ],
                    close: CloseIcon [ x = { parent.width - 28 }, y = 12, iconSize = 15,
                        ink = { this.$provided("theme").textMuted },
                        onClick() { this.root.closeDetail() }
                        ]
                    ],
                title: TextInput [ x = 13, y = 40, width = { parent.width - 26 }, height = 32, fontSize = 16, fontWeight = bold,
                    textColor = { this.$provided("theme").text }, placeholder = "Untitled event",
                    fill = { this.$provided("theme").fieldBg },
                    stroke = { stroke(1, this.focused ? this.$provided("theme").accent : this.$provided("theme").fieldEdge) },
                    text <-> :title ],
                meta: Text [ x = 15, y = 84, fontSize = 12.5, wrap = false, textColor = { this.$provided("theme").textMuted },
                    text = { this.root.dayLabel(this.$data(["y"]) + "-" + this.$data(["m"]) + "-" + this.$data(["d"])) + "  ·  " + this.root.shortTime(this.$data(["start"])) + " – " + this.root.shortTime(this.$data(["end"])) } ]
                ],

            DetailSection [ idx = 0, label = "NOTES",     field = "notes" ],
            DetailSection [ idx = 1, label = "LOCATION",  field = "location" ],
            DetailSection [ idx = 2, label = "ATTENDEES", field = "attendees" ]
            ]
        ],

    // the grabbed event, following the pointer during a drag

    ghost: View [ visible = { this.root.dragging }, opacity = 0.9, x = { this.root.pointerX - this.root.grabDX }, y = { this.root.pointerY - this.root.grabDY },
        width = { this.root.dragW }, height = { Math.max(this.root.dragH, 34) }, cornerRadius = 6, clip = true, fill = { this.root.catFill(this.root.dragCat) },
